Survival basics

Collect scrap along the road, then return home

Check your tools’ durability before leaving and bring spare tools and basic supplies. Link nearby roads, town outskirts and barrel areas into a loop. Return home to store your haul after one circuit instead of continuing farther and farther.

If an area has already been looted, move to the next stretch rather than waiting there. End the trip when your tools are nearly broken or you have collected plenty of scrap. Your haul depends on the route and other players, so do not chase a fixed hourly yield.
